description: The line plot titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature" illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at every 0.1 interval. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," is also a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at every 2.5 interval. The On-policy RL line is represented by a red line with star markers, the LUFFY line by a blue line with triangle markers, and the SFT line by a green line with square markers. The On-policy RL line shows a general upward trend, starting at approximately 67.5% accuracy at 0.1 temperature and ending at around 80% at 1.0 temperature. The LUFFY line fluctuates more, starting at about 67.5% and ending near 75%. The SFT line also fluctuates, starting at around 67.5% and ending close to 75%. The plot does not provide specific data points for peaks, declines, or steady trends beyond the general trends observed.
